title: Fungi
subtitle: Threads in the dark
summary: A mushroom is the fruit. The fungus is the mat of threads underneath, spread through soil and wood and digesting its food outside its body. These lessons follow the threads into tree roots and rotting logs, and to the mould on Fleming's plate.

release.note: Every lesson is written: sixteen on how fungi live and three branches, on lichens, Northwest forests and how fungi are named and counted, each with figures you can work. Photos come later.
